column1: # Source: written for this pack (GPL-3.0-or-later). The rows are single word forms and short phrases: forms of the regular Old Irish paradigms (Thurneysen, A Grammar of Old Irish; Stifter, Sengoídelc), forms checked against Wiktionary's inflection tables (kaikki.org, CC BY-SA 4.0), and words of the Táin (Strachan and O'Keeffe 1912, public domain) and the Würzburg glosses (CC BY 4.0) whose lookups the measurements showed to need a test (README.md, Measurements). No sentence, gloss or dictionary entry is copied. The pack has no optional processor or transform, so these rows run as a lookup does by default.
